method: Grand Cayman, every coast: North Sound and the North Wall, the North Side and East End, the south coast and South Sound, and the west coast from George Town to Northwest Point. The official list is the Cayman Islands Department of Environment public-mooring spreadsheet (January 2023 update, linked from doe.ky/resources/public-moorings), 235 named moorings with depth and WGS84 coordinates; it counts as one list, and a site moored more than once (Stingray City east and west, Round Rock, Oro Verde bow and stern, Eden Rock, Devil's Grotto, Japanese Gardens, Bullwinkle, Pallas Pinnacle) is one row at its first mooring. Operator site lists, each one list: Ocean Frontiers (its 55 East End sites), Red Sail Sports (its dive-sites page, East End wall tour and blog guides; Tortuga Divers is Red Sail and adds nothing), Divetech (its site guides and favourite-site posts; a post that only reports diving Babylon with another shop does not count), Living the Dream Divers, Indigo Divers, Cayman Turtle Divers, Sunset Divers, Eden Rock Diving Center and CU Divers. Don Foster's, Divers Down, Deep Blue Divers and Ambassador Divers publish no site names; the CITA Dive365 site copies the DoE moorings and is not independent; Explore Cayman, DivePlannerPro and magazines were read for leads only. A site is counted when it is on two lists. Operator names are matched to moorings by name; five matches rest on a near-identical name at the same place in the operator's sequence and say so in the row name (Dumbo's Drop-Off, Black Rock Reef, Breakers' Cutback, Princess Penny's Pinnacle, Lone Star Ledges). Excluded: names on the mooring list or one operator list only, the eight sites the DoE removed for the 2021 no-diving zones (still named by some operators), the George Town yacht moorings, and the Stingray City sandbar, which is a wade-depth snorkel stop; Stingray City itself, moored at 12 ft and sold as a dive, is counted. No moored site is beyond recreational depth (the deepest mooring is 85 ft). Counted 2026-10-14.
